## Change / 变更

Describe the problem and the resulting documentation or workflow.

说明问题及改进后的文档或工作流。

## Verification / 验证

- Actual app/tool version and platform, or fictional sample only / 实测版本与平台，或仅虚构样本：
- Reproduction and result / 复现步骤与结果：
- Paired translation / 配对译文：

## Before review / 评审前

- [ ] Original text and fictional data only; no private content, credentials, real logs, or images / 原创文字和虚构数据，不含私有内容、凭据、真实日志或图片
- [ ] Planned capabilities remain labeled as planned / 规划能力仍标为规划
- [ ] Data destinations, limitations, recovery, and ownership are stated / 已说明数据去向、限制、恢复及编写归属
- [ ] English and Chinese meanings match / 中英文含义一致
- [ ] Local documentation checks and content/history scans passed / 本地文档检查及内容与历史扫描通过
- [ ] I have the right to contribute under the MIT license / 有权以 MIT 许可贡献

Never paste scanner findings, personal transcripts, or credentials here. Report security issues privately.

不要粘贴扫描命中内容、个人转写或凭据；安全问题使用私密报告。
